purpose: Compute exact rank upper bounds from each of the three K-rational 2-isogenies of the q=84/13 model38 elliptic quotient over K=Q(i). This is a distinct isogeny-Selmer route, not another full multiplication-by-2 descent or cover search.
method_contract: Construct E exactly and enumerate all three nonzero K-rational 2-torsion points via TwoTorsionSubgroup(E).

For each nonzero 2-torsion point P construct phi=TwoIsogeny(P), then call RankBound(E : Isogeny:=phi). This invokes the phi and dual-isogeny Selmer machinery, whose Selmer groups are exact upper bounds for E(K)/phi E'(K) and hence for the Mordell-Weil rank.
Retain each kernel point, codomain coefficients, and returned integer rank bound. Require exactly three distinct nonzero kernel points.
If any exact isogeny rank bound is 0, rank(E38)=0 is a PREAUDIT proof candidate. If all are >=1, this route grants no rank closure. Runtime/transport errors are OPEN.
theorem_sources: Magma V2.29 Mordell-Weil/Descent handbook: SelmerGroup(phi) is implemented for 2-isogenies over number fields and bounds E(K)/phi E'(K).
Magma V2.29 example with full 2-torsion explicitly compares RankBound(E : Isogeny:=phi) for all three 2-isogenies.
credit: PREAUDIT rank-zero candidate only if an exact returned isogeny bound is 0. No rational-X, parent pullback, branch/sign-partner, or receiver closure without subsequent exact adapters and hostile audit.
